items.details: Use a normal campaign for this collection project. The selected baseline rescues Zote before Mantis Claw and Bretta in Fungal Wastes so their optional later encounter remains available. After an ending, reload this save to return before its final encounter; ordinary ending completion does not erase the campaign. To see all five variants on one save, finish Ending A before acquiring Void Heart, then B/C; see D before giving Godseeker the flower, then E. Those permanent changes cannot be undone by selecting another app route. Grimm ritual and banishment require different save histories to see both. Use a separate fresh campaign or a supported earlier platform backup; this app cannot create or restore a console save. Shared checks represent guide coverage across attempts, not separate game saves. Steel Soul and speed goals are separate optional runs, not PS5 platinum prerequisites.

guides.title: Combat rhythm and safe healing

title_i18n.pt: Ritmo de combate e cura segura

guides.summary: Learn the opening before extending a combo.

summary_i18n.en: Learn the opening before extending a combo.
summary_i18n.pt: Aprenda a abertura antes de prolongar uma sequência.

guides.body: Most encounters reward recognizing an attack, avoiding it and taking a short damage window. Do not spend all your SOUL healing while a boss is still attacking: a failed Focus can cost the resource and another mask. Staggers and long committed recovery animations are better opportunities. Downward nail strikes can bounce off enemies and some hazards, which is useful for movement as well as damage. Learn one reliable response to each attack before adding aggressive charm combinations.

Do not spend all your SOUL healing while a boss is still attacking: a failed Focus can cost the resource and another mask. Staggers and long committed recovery animations are better opportunities. Downward nail strikes can bounce off enemies and some hazards, which is useful for movement as well as damage. Learn one reliable response to each attack before adding aggressive charm combinations.
body_i18n.pt: A maioria dos encontros recompensa reconhecer um ataque, evitá-lo e aproveitar uma abertura curta. Golpes descendentes de ferrão podem impulsionar o personagem em inimigos e alguns perigos, sendo úteis para movimentação e dano. Aprenda uma resposta confiável a cada ataque antes de acrescentar combinações agressivas de amuletos.

guides.title: Death, the Shade and Geo recovery

title_i18n.en: Death, the Shade and Geo recovery

guides.summary: Recover deliberately instead of rushing into a second loss.

summary_i18n.en: Recover deliberately instead of rushing into a second loss.
summary_i18n.pt: Recupere com cuidado em vez de correr para uma segunda perda.

guides.body: On a normal save, an ordinary overworld death leaves a Shade carrying your lost Geo and reduces your usable SOUL capacity until you recover it. Defeat that Shade to restore the missing resources. Dying again before recovering the previous Shade replaces it and loses the earlier Geo, so first secure a safe return path rather than sprinting through enemies. Confessor Jiji offers another recovery option after her door is opened, using a Rancid Egg. This system is not a safety net for Steel Soul's permanent-death rules.

summary_i18n.en: Balance damage and recovery instead of hoarding the entire meter.

guides.body: Nail hits against suitable targets generate SOUL. Focus spends it to heal, while spells offer ranged, upward or downward damage depending on what you have learned. Compare the in-game percentage after obtaining World Sense, fill missing counted objectives, then finish an ending after reaching 112% for Pure Completion. Do not force Void Heart solely to pursue 112%: Kingsoul can retain its collection credit for a no-Void-Heart ending project.
